rationale: Resident must first attempt to convince attending to disclose; direct communication is the first step before escalating to ethics committee.
Ototoxicity + sensorineural hearing loss in bladder cancer chemotherapy points to cisplatin, which works by cross-linking DNA.
Post-catheterization with livedo reticularis, eosinophilia, AKI, and intravascular cholesterol clefts (spindle-shaped vacuoles) is classic cholesterol embolization.
Septic shock + DIC + pelvic source with LPS (lipid A = phosphorylated GlcNAc disaccharide with fatty acids) indicates gram-negative sepsis; E. coli ferments lactose on MacConkey.
Classic seasonal allergic conjunctivitis; ketotifen (mast cell stabilizer/antihistamine) eye drops are first-line.
Cocaine-induced chest pain; benzos are preferred but among options, diltiazem (CCB) addresses HTN and coronary vasoconstriction. Beta-blockers contraindicated due to unopposed alpha.
Older patient with PAD and unilateral hydronephrosis suggests common iliac artery aneurysm compressing the ureter.
Post-PCI for NSTEMI, dual antiplatelet therapy (aspirin + clopidogrel) is standard.
Active PID is an absolute contraindication to copper IUD placement; the other options are contraindications for hormonal methods.
Nail pitting in a young woman strongly suggests psoriasis, which presents with silvery plaques on extensor surfaces.
HIV confirmatory testing now uses the HIV-1/HIV-2 antibody differentiation immunoassay (replaced Western blot per CDC algorithm).
Primary myelofibrosis (massive splenomegaly, marrow fibrosis, JAK2+) treated with ruxolitinib, a JAK2 inhibitor.
Bilateral vestibular schwannomas + merlin mutation on chr 22 = NF2; increased risk of meningiomas.
Standing decreases venous return and preload, increasing HR which reduces diastolic filling time.
Reassortment of segmented genomes occurs with segmented viruses like rotavirus (Reoviridae).
Calcified gallbladder (porcelain gallbladder) carries high risk of gallbladder adenocarcinoma, which must be excluded.
IL-4 promotes B-cell class switching to IgE in allergic asthma.
Pairing cases with controls on confounding variables is matching.
Acute pericarditis: NSAIDs (ibuprofen) plus colchicine is first-line therapy.
Low BAC with sedation, ataxia, diminished reflexes, normal pupils suggests benzodiazepine intoxication.
Previous radiation therapy is a known risk factor for secondary diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.
VSD (holosystolic murmur LLSB) with acyanotic CHF symptoms is associated with 22q11 deletion (DiGeorge).
Mississippi River valley + dimorphic fungus + macrophages with intracellular yeast = Histoplasma capsulatum.
Hospital-acquired pneumonia after 1 week; S. aureus is a common HAP pathogen.
Silent chest with lethargy after maximal asthma therapy indicates impending respiratory failure requiring intubation.
Negative NBT and recurrent catalase-positive organism infections = chronic granulomatous disease, defective respiratory burst.
Barking cough and stridor = croup; X-ray shows steeple sign (subglottic narrowing).
Rifampin induces CYP3A4, accelerating estrogen/progestin metabolism.
Post-diarrheal ascending weakness with diminished reflexes = Guillain-Barre; CSF shows albuminocytologic dissociation (increased protein, normal cell count).
Flexible metatarsus adductus (correctable with stimulation) typically resolves spontaneously; reassurance is appropriate.
Cholescintigraphy showing intrahepatic ducts but no gallbladder filling = cystic duct obstruction (acute cholecystitis).
Elderly with palpitations/dyspnea and PV loop shifted up/left (diastolic dysfunction) = increased ventricular wall stiffness (HFpEF).
Aplastic anemia after antibiotic in Guatemala (where it is still used)—chloramphenicol causes aplastic anemia.
Hypertrophic gastropathy with parietal atrophy and hypoalbuminemia (edema) = Menetrier disease (mucus cell hyperplasia).
DKA resolved after insulin/fluids; now needs supportive monitoring.
Asymmetric arthritis + nail pitting + scalp scaling (dandruff = psoriasis) = psoriatic arthritis.
Proximal weakness improving with exercise + autonomic symptoms + no response to anticholinesterase = Lambert-Eaton (paraneoplastic from SCLC).
Persistent diarrhea, candidiasis, RSV in infant with negative HIV = T cell defect (SCID).
TI = TD50/ED50. ED50 around 20mg, TD50 around 60mg. Therefore TI = 60/20 = 3, closest is 2.67.
Fluent speech with intact comprehension but impaired repetition = conduction aphasia from arcuate fasciculus damage.
Hirsutism, acne, oligomenorrhea, obesity, IGT = PCOS (Rotterdam criteria).
Diabetic peripheral neuropathy progression is best prevented by strict glycemic control.
Down syndrome (quad screen pattern) + bilious vomiting + polyhydramnios = duodenal atresia.
Coronary sinus has lowest O2 content because heart extracts maximum O2 from blood at rest and exercise.
Multiparous woman with menorrhagia, bulk symptoms, irregular enlarged uterus = fibroids (leiomyoma).
Severe anion-gap metabolic acidosis in alcoholic with normal salicylate—suspect methanol/ethylene glycol; fomepizole is treatment.
Unilateral calf claudication with absent pedal pulses but palpable femoral pulse localizes lesion to femoropopliteal segment.
Stillbirth at 35 weeks with no obvious cause—autopsy is the most informative next step.
Type II pneumocytes (surfactant-secreting) proliferate to regenerate alveolar epithelium.
Ionizing radiation causes double-strand DNA breaks via free radicals.
Resistant hypertension + hypokalemia + metabolic alkalosis = primary hyperaldosteronism.
Conjugated hyperbilirubinemia (bilirubin in urine) with low urobilinogen suggests biliary obstruction (defective excretion).
Galantamine (AChE inhibitor) causing cholinergic side effects; atropine antagonizes muscarinic effects.
Lip smacking, blinking, chronic neuroleptic exposure = tardive dyskinesia.
Tinea cruris (groin itching with scaly patch); KOH prep confirms dermatophyte.
Risperidone increases prolactin, causing gynecomastia/galactorrhea.
Tampon-associated TSS via TSST-1 superantigen binding to MHC II and variable beta region of TCR.
Post-diarrheal MAHA, thrombocytopenia, AKI in child after Mexico trip = HUS (Shiga toxin from EHEC).
Bulimia nervosa with normal BMI; patients can transition between anorexia and bulimia.
Travel to Indonesia + stepwise fever, rose spots, hepatosplenomegaly = typhoid fever (S. typhi).
Metronidazole inhibits aldehyde dehydrogenase causing acetaldehyde accumulation (disulfiram-like).
Mild normocytic anemia at 16 weeks is physiologic dilutional anemia of pregnancy.
Postoperative urinary retention after anticholinergic/opioid premedication; straight cath relieves bladder.
Oral thrush (pseudomembranes wiping off) in young man—azole antifungal (inhibits 14-alpha-demethylase).
Subacute back pain, worse at night, history of lung cancer = bony metastases (lytic lesions).
Emergency life/limb-threatening surgery in minor with parents unreachable; implied consent—proceed.
Neonatal hyperthyroidism (mother with Graves') from transplacental TSI/TSH receptor antibodies.
Esophageal varices secondary prevention with nonselective beta-blocker nadolol.
2cm liver lesion with arterial enhancement in cirrhotic = HCC; resection is appropriate if resectable.
Hepatic encephalopathy with fever and ascites—SBP is most likely precipitant.
Blunt chest trauma + elevated troponin + elevated PCWP + chest wall bruising = cardiac contusion.
Hepatorenal syndrome in decompensated cirrhotic; definitive treatment is liver transplantation.
Hyperthyroidism (likely Graves'); radioiodine is definitive single treatment.
Hypopigmented rash post-tropical travel = tinea versicolor; KOH prep shows spaghetti and meatballs.
Cri-du-chat syndrome (high-pitched cry, microcephaly, epicanthal folds) = chromosome 5p deletion.
Postmenopausal vaginal mass requires biopsy to rule out vaginal cancer.
Hemochromatosis arthropathy (high transferrin sat, ferritin, MCP involvement, diabetes) with CPP deposition.
Cyanotic newborn + egg-shaped heart + atrial septostomy = transposition of great vessels.
Penetrating cardiac injury requires surgical repair with pledgeted sutures.
Smoker with productive cough and cor pulmonale = chronic bronchitis; Reid index >50% is the pathologic finding.
Follicular lymphoma t(14;18) overexpresses BCL-2, which inhibits caspase-9-mediated apoptosis.
African-American patients are at highest risk for acral lentiginous melanoma.
Polymyalgia rheumatica with elevated ESR/CRP—screen for giant cell arteritis (jaw claudication).
Infertility + cyclic dysmenorrhea + dyschezia = endometriosis (endometrial tissue outside uterus).
Prosthetic valve + splinter hemorrhages = infective endocarditis with vegetations on valve.
Suspected endometriosis with normal imaging—diagnostic laparoscopy is gold standard.
LDL 186 with family history of premature CAD is indication for statin therapy.
Widened mediastinum + NG tube deviation + depressed mainstem after MVC = traumatic aortic rupture.
Hyperthyroidism in 1st trimester—PTU is preferred (methimazole teratogenic in 1st trimester).
Schistosoma mansoni (lateral spine eggs, hepatic granulomas, periportal fibrosis) acquired via freshwater snails.
TOF patients can have iron deficiency anemia despite normal Hb due to relative polycythemia masking it.
Acute waxing/waning confusion, inattentiveness, sundowning post-op in elderly = delirium.
Atlantoaxial instability (cervical clunk) in patient with intellectual disability suggests Down syndrome.
Cardiac tamponade (Beck's triad); pulsus paradoxus = SBP drop >10 mmHg with inspiration.
ADPKD with HTN and family history; screen for berry aneurysms with MR angiography.
PE with normal aPTT response to heparin suggests antithrombin III deficiency (autosomal dominant).
Neisseria gonorrhoeae undergoes antigenic variation of pilins, preventing lasting immunity.
Trauma with neck pain—cervical immobilization is the immediate first step before imaging.
Bromocriptine is a dopamine agonist and decreases prolactin; the other antipsychotics increase prolactin and cause galactorrhea.
